recorded.rule: Q2 v2: a giveaway, read from the question's own text alone
recorded.prompt:q-module-access: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. Pick an option only when the wording itself singles it out: it is longer or more specific than the others, it repeats words from the stem, the others carry absolute terms such as 'always' or 'never', the stem's grammar fits it alone, or it restates the stem. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.

recorded.prompt:q-module-access:b: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-module-access:b: an independent reader (41-reflection q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-module-access:b: ruled out: "setAccessible(true) on a member of a package in a named module that is not opened to your module throws InaccessibleObjectException" -- the exception fires on the setAccessible call itself, not on a later get().
recorded.prompt:q-module-access:c: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-module-access:c: an independent reader (41-reflection q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-module-access:c: ruled out: Same passage: setAccessible throws InaccessibleObjectException in this case; it does not simply return and let the field read normally.
recorded.prompt:q-class-literal:a: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-class-literal:a: an independent reader (41-reflection q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-class-literal:a: ruled out: "TypeName.class ... The first time it is evaluated at run time, the JVM loads the class if it is not loaded yet, but it does NOT initialize it (no static initializer runs)." This contrasts explicitly with Class.forName(), which does trigger initialization.
recorded.prompt:q-class-literal:b: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-class-literal:b: an independent reader (41-reflection q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-class-literal:b: ruled out: Same passage: "The first time it is evaluated at run time, the JVM loads the class if it is not loaded yet" -- something does happen at run time (loading), so it is not true that nothing happens.
